text:
anna_docs: Heads-up — staging mkdocs linkcheck failing after the latest docs merge. Looks like a table caption generated the same slug as an existing manual anchor, so cross-page links 404ing.

anna_docs: Error excerpt:
```
LinkcheckError: /guides/setup/#table-caption -> 404
Slug conflict: 'table-caption' appears 2 times (guides/setup.md:42, integrations/compat.md:17)
```

mike_infra: Ugh. Could be mkdocs-material's slugify behavior changed, or soft hyphens/nonbreaking spaces sneaking into captions. Any quick workaround to unblock staging?

joey_engineering: We can do two things: 1) add explicit HTML anchors or explicit header IDs where collisions happen, 2) adjust the slugify plugin to normalize invisible chars and dedupe collisions deterministically.

anna_docs: I tried adding an explicit anchor near the table but mkdocs table caption handling doesn't always preserve inline HTML ids.

sophia_writer: I can edit the caption text to avoid special chars and add an explicit id on the nearest heading as a short-term patch. Will open a tiny PR.

ci-bot: Build failed on commit abc1234 — linkcheck error raised. Full CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/12345

joey_engineering: I'll propose a fix in the docs repo: a small slug-normalizer hook that strips soft-hyphens, zero-width spaces, and runs unicodedata.normalize('NFKD') before slugify. Also add a linkcheck regression test to catch dup slugs.

mike_infra: Good idea. Can we also add a pre-linkcheck step that emits a list of collisions so authors get actionable diagnostics? I can add that to our CI pipeline (fast and low risk).

anna_docs: OK plan: Sophia will do the content tweak to unblock (PR 5124), Joey will open a slug-normalizer + regression test PR (PR 5123), Mike will add the collision-report CI step. I'll coordinate review and merge order.

sophia_writer: PR 5124 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5124 — changes caption and adds explicit heading id. Small, should be quick.

joey_engineering: Draft PR 5123 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 — slug-normalizer + test. Needs a quick review for Python unicode behavior.

mike_infra: I'll add the CI job in a separate PR and wire it after Joey's test lands so CI doesn't break.

ci-bot: PR 5124 status: checks passed, preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/5124

anna_docs: Merged PR 5124 — staging linkcheck re-run queued.

ci-bot: Staging linkcheck passed on head (after merge). No more 404s for that anchor.

joey_engineering: Great — I'll iterate on the normalizer in PR 5123 and aim to get it reviewed tomorrow.

mike_infra: Will file the CI collision-report job as follow-up.

anna_docs: Thanks everyone — nice coordinated patching. Leaving a short note in the docs migration checklist to watch for table caption collisions and to prefer explicit header IDs when in doubt. :tada:
